guidancePolicy: may-generate-new (a generator may synthesize a fresh, on-brand asset for this role) | must-reuse-exact-or-omit (the generator must reuse one of the real, already-bundled files verbatim, or omit the field entirely -- it must never invent a new one) | must-not-fabricate (stricter than reuse-or-omit: this role must never be populated by a generator at all; a human supplies it)

screenshot.note: product-UI screenshots (e.g. Hero.jsx's accounts-table image) depict the real, specific product surface -- reuse the exact bundled file or omit.

customer-logo.note: REAL third-party company logos (Y Combinator, Village Global, Apple, Intuit, Convoy, Berkeley plus the LogoStrip rotator's 9 customer logos) -- a generator must never fabricate a new logo or a variation of a real one. Compliance-critical: these are real companies' real marks.

customer-photo.note: REAL named customer headshots (Jennifer Lye / Latchel, Kate Anand / Lexamica, JD Reichenbach / Rho) paired with a real quote and real name -- never generate a new 'customer' photo, name or quote; omission is always the safe fallback.

partner-logo.note: REAL third-party integration-vendor logos (Gmail, HubSpot, Intercom, Salesforce, Slack, Linear, Zendesk, etc., 40+ total per PAGES_ASSET_MANIFEST.json) -- never fabricate a new integration partner or logo variation.

team-photo.note: real photography used on the About hero -- reuse exact or omit; do not generate new people.

blog-cover.note: every one of the 21 posts shares the identical CMS cover image on the real source -- reuse that exact file for any blog-post/blog-index instance; never generate a distinct cover per post.

case-study-cover.note: every one of the 18 case studies shares the identical placeholder cover image on the real source -- same rule as blog-cover.

decorative-illustration.note: abstract SVG hero art (e.g. blog-hero-arrow.svg) with no real-world referent -- safe for a generator to synthesize a new on-brand variant.

decorative-icon.note: abstract feature/value SVG icons (icon-ask-ai.svg, about-empathy.svg, etc.) -- no real-world referent, safe to generate new ones in the same style.

product-video.note: real captured product-UI screen recordings (Feature_A/B/C.mp4, ProductOverview 1-4.mp4) -- depict the actual product; never generate a synthetic substitute.

rive-animation.note: 15+ real .riv motion-graphics files with hand-authored artboards/state machines -- a generator cannot meaningfully author a new one; reuse an exact existing file+artboard pair or omit the decorative layer entirely.
rive-animation.measuredFrom: src/components/sub/shared.jsx:7-14 (RIV map) plus per-section RiveCanvas src usages
